div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 是否已完成付款或财务确认？

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 保持待结算状态并等待付款事件

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 进入正式结算

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 再次锁定员工额度账户

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 原流水变动类型

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 冻结额度转为正式已使用额度

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 待入额度转为员工可用额度

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 关闭审计流水，不改变余额

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 追加已生效结算流水

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 回写数据库和四张多维表格

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 通知财务和员工最终余额及 OA 流水号

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 归档发票、审批、通知和全部审计记录

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 本次报销处理完成

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 财务在异常处理表收到待办

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 人工处理结论

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 员工补充资料并重新触发审核

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 经财务确认后按全额缺口计算

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 终止自动记账并通知 OA 审批人

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 记录授权人和特殊处理意见

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 按财务确认金额生成待处理流水

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 结算后发生红冲、作废、退款或记账错误

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 创建冲正申请，不删除原流水

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 财务审批冲正

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 追加反向流水并更新额度、发票和多维表格

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 通知相关员工和财务并保留完整审计链

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 追加释放流水并同步多维表格

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 流程关闭
